model_annotation:
The image presents two bar charts, one for Germany (Deutschland) and one for the European Union (EU), illustrating the percentage of three metals - Aluminium, Kupfer (Copper), and Nickel - over three years: 2021, 2022, and 2023. The horizontal axis lists the metals, while the vertical axis represents the percentage, ranging from 0% to 30% in increments of 5%. The bars are color-coded to represent the years: blue for 2021, purple for 2022, and grey for 2023. 

In the Germany chart, the percentages for Aluminium are 3.6% in 2021, 2.7% in 2022, and 1.0% in 2023; for Kupfer, the percentages are 8.3% in 2021, 11.3% in 2022, and 2.2% in 2023; and for Nickel, the percentages are 25.1% in 2021, 24.7% in 2022, and 11.4% in 2023. 

In the EU chart, the percentages for Aluminium are 3.2% in 2021, 2.8% in 2022, and 1.7% in 2023; for Kupfer, the percentages are 4.4% in 2021, 5.1% in 2022, and 1.3% in 2023; and for Nickel, the percentages are 24.3% in 2021, 23.3% in 2022, and 14.6% in 2023. The charts provide a clear visual representation of the trends in the percentages of these metals over the three-year period for both Germany and the EU.
